title: Who is Yinlin? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 862 'Profile Reveal | Evil-conquering Puppet — Yinlin': a Congenital Resonator who was once a remarkable Patroller; following the loss of her identity in a case, she resides in the shadows, delving into the depths of crime alone. Key art quote: 'Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... We don't talk about that in public.' Attribute Electro, 5 stars, affiliation Jinzhou

Official news 862 lore images: Master of Lies (never failed to earn someone's trust even when she spoke nothing but lies; perps screamed 'She can't be a Patroller!' when apprehended); Always Has a Plan B (always having a second key in the pocket and another bullet in the chamber); Zapstring the Puppet (once an ordinary puppet, now a fierce weapon thanks to her retooling); Unmasked Holidays (in private she relegates daily life to Zapstring; most nicks and dents on Zapstring came from household chores, not battles); Net of Lightning (weaves electricity into a net of purple-red sparks and a cage to entice the enemy)
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: Name's Yinlin. As for what she does? We don't talk about that in public. This is Yinlin, in Wuthering Waves.
She was once a remarkable Patroller. But after she lost her identity in a case, she moved into the shadows, hunting crime alone.
She's a master of lies, and still earns everyone's trust. Caught criminals have screamed: she can't be a Patroller!
Her rule? Always have a Plan B: a second key in the pocket, and another bullet in the chamber.
Her partner is Zapstring, a puppet she rebuilt into a weapon. Most of its dents? Not from battle. From doing her household chores.
In battle, she weaves lightning into a net, a cage to trap her enemies. She's a five-star Electro Resonator.
So, would you trust Yinlin? Tell me in the comments.
